messages:
hugo: heads-up — saw an awkward parity/behavior gap between REST and the Java SDK for the admin list routes. REST returns paginated `next_cursor` when results > page_size; Java SDK returns the full list but with a different default page_size and silently auto-paginates by making sequential requests, which breaks client-side rate limits and causes our retry wrapper to kick in. users hit 429s in sampleapp. :grimacing:
maya: hmm. do you have a tiny repro? which endpoint?
hugo: admin/routes/list used in sampleapp onboarding. curl (expected behavior):
```bash
curl -X GET \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  'https://api.redwood.ai/admin/routes?limit=50'
```
-> gets up to 50 items + header/field `next_cursor` if more. client can choose to call again.

hugo: Java SDK snippet in sampleapp (published v1.2.0):
```java
List<Route> routes = client.admin().routes().list();
// Observed behavior: SDK ignores limit param and auto-fetches all pages under the hood, returning a combined list of 1200 items. This causes burst of requests during onboarding and triggers 429 from gateway.
```

trent: that's not great. Is the SDK doing background pagination or synchronous sequential calls?
hugo: synchronous sequential calls. Implementation had convenience auto-paginate to "help users" but it wasn't opt-in and uses default page_size=100. REST default is 50. Also the SDK retry/backoff treats the whole list call as idempotent and will retry the entire combined operation on transient 5xx, which then repeats the 1200-item fetch and amplifies the issue.
maya: two separate problems: (1) behavior drift (auto-pagination + different default limit), (2) retry semantics applied to a non-idempotent composite operation. Both need fixes.

qa-bot: test failure T-9802: onboarding_sampleapp_rate_limit_flake observed on staging — sampleapp list call caused 429 on nightly runs. Repro shows Java SDK returned >1000 items in one shot.

trent: short-term mitigation ideas: (a) patch sampleapp to pass explicit limit param (e.g., limit=50) and iterate using provided cursor rather than relying on SDK convenience, (b) change Java SDK to add an opt-in pager (ListOptions.autoPaginate=false by default), (c) adjust retry middleware to consider a composite paginated call non-retriable unless an idempotency key is provided.
maya: +1. Also add a quick compatibility check in CI that compares SDK default page_size to REST default for list endpoints. We've had a few bugs from SDKs changing defaults.
hugo: I'll open RED-3650 and attach failing traces and sampleapp diffs. Plan: quick sampleapp change today to stop bursts, then a Java SDK patch for v1.2.1 to introduce explicit pager and preserve REST defaults.

devex: Please include a migration note in the release: "Java SDK no longer auto-paginates by default; use .listAll() convenience if you need full export." Also call out changed default page_size to match REST.

trent: for retry policy, we should detect when a client operation performed N sequential requests as part of a single API call and avoid retrying the whole thing. Short-term we can mark list endpoints as safe to retry per-page rather than per-operation. I'll add an RFC ticket.

ops-bot: infra logs linked: https://logs.redwood.ai/org/stack/RED-3650 — multiple 429 spikes correlated with sampleapp Java onboarding.

qa-bot: assigned test T-9802 to @qa to validate sampleapp after patch and to add an e2e that asserts SDK pagination behavior matches REST when using defaults.

maya: thanks. follow-ups: (1) patch sampleapp snippet to be explicit about pagination, (2) Java SDK patch to stop silent auto-pagination and align defaults, (3) retry middleware tweak to avoid amplifying multi-request operations, (4) add parity CI job comparing raw SDK requests to REST fixtures for list endpoints. tagging @devex and @eng-runtime for visibility.
